name: Ploid
long_description:
Ploid is the AI-native people data infrastructure for developers and companies building products, workflows, and agents around people.

We've built an index of 2B+ people across professional and social sources, giving developers one API to search for people, enrich profiles, find emails and phone numbers, resolve identities, and retrieve up-to-date information from across the web. Unlike traditional people databases built around static records, Ploid combines its massive people index with real-time retrieval and identity resolution, delivering fresh, reliable information whenever it's needed. From sales and recruiting to customer intelligence, trust and safety, and AI agents, Ploid replaces fragmented data providers with a single infrastructure layer.

2B+ people. One API. Built for AI.
one_liner: The people data company for the agent era

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Co-founder and CEO of Ploid, a YC-backed people data and intelligence platform built on a proprietary index of more than 2 billion people, it powers natural language search, contact enrichment, and live crawling of any website. Before Ploid, Manny was the youngest engineer at Wander, where he worked on AI/ML recommendations, and he did LLM research at NYU. He grew up in the Chicago suburbs, and has lived in New York, Shanghai, and San Francisco. He also writes about the philosophy of AI.

founders.title: Founder/COO
founders.founder_bio: Kamran did STEM Olympiad in Germany, selected as one of the top scorers out of 1,000+ students nationwide, and won two gold medals (math and science) against 5,000+ competitors. Received the City of Sarajevo's April 6th Youth Award. Previously did neuroscience research at Tsinghua University.
